dialogues.jp: まったく青い空。
dialogues.en: What a beautiful blue sky.
dialogues.text: What a beautiful blue sky.

dialogues.jp: まったくきれいな桜。
dialogues.en: And beautiful cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text: And beautiful cherry blossoms.

dialogues.jp: 「……まったく眠いな」
dialogues.en: "I'm so tired."
dialogues.text: "I'm so tired."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「春休みボケは早く治さなきゃね〜」
dialogues.en: "I have to get used to the routine of school days."
dialogues.text: "I have to get used to the routine of school days."

dialogues.jp: 隣を歩くさくらが、しみじみと呟く。
dialogues.en: Sakura says with feeling, walking next to me.
dialogues.text: Sakura says with feeling, walking next to me.

dialogues.jp:
なんというのか、私服のさくらと並んで歩いて
いると目だって仕方がないのだが、こんなもん
気にしていても始まらない。
dialogues.en:
I stand out when I walk in uniform next to Sakura in
everyday clothes, but I have no other choice. I try not to
worry about it.
dialogues.text:
I stand out when I walk in uniform next to Sakura in
everyday clothes, but I have no other choice. I try not to
worry about it.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの噂なんてすぐに学園中に広まるだろう
し、俺の従姉だということも、すぐにリークさ
れるだろう。
dialogues.en:
I know people will start talking about Sakura soon, and
eventually they'll find out I'm blood related with her.
dialogues.text:
I know people will start talking about Sakura soon, and
eventually they'll find out I'm blood related with her.

dialogues.jp:
学園の中で生活している限り、どうにもならな
いことだ。
dialogues.en: I have no choice but accept this if I attend this school.
dialogues.text: I have no choice but accept this if I attend this school.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、お兄ちゃん……」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan..."
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「抱きつき♪」
dialogues.en: "Hug!"
dialogues.text: "Hug!"

dialogues.jp:
ぐっ、とさくらが腰にしがみついて足が進まな
くなる。
dialogues.en: Sakura grabs my legs and I can't move forward.
dialogues.text: Sakura grabs my legs and I can't move forward.

dialogues.en: "Heavy..."
dialogues.text: "Heavy..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「レディーに抱きつかれて重いって、ダメだよ、
　そんなんじゃ？」
dialogues.en: "You can't say 'heavy' when a lady's hanging on to you."
dialogues.text: "You can't say 'heavy' when a lady's hanging on to you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「レディーは｛・・・・・・・／しがみついたり｝しねぇだろうが
　……」
dialogues.en: "Ladies don't cling on like you."
dialogues.text: "Ladies don't cling on like you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「親子みたいだな」
dialogues.en: "You two are like a parent and a child."
dialogues.text: "You two are like a parent and a child."

dialogues.jp:
ぼそり、と通り過ぎざまに恐ろしいことを呟い
たのは杉並だった。
dialogues.en: Suginami says a horrifying thing as he passes me.
dialogues.text: Suginami says a horrifying thing as he passes me.

dialogues.jp:
「……それだけは考えないようにしていたもの
　を」
dialogues.en: "That was a thought I really didn't want to have."
dialogues.text: "That was a thought I really didn't want to have."

dialogues.jp: ｛いきようよう／意気揚々｝と遠ざかっていく背中に｛うめ／呻｝く。
dialogues.en: I mutter as he walks away in triumph.
dialogues.text: I mutter as he walks away in triumph.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「親子？」
dialogues.en: "A parent and a child?"
dialogues.text: "A parent and a child?"

dialogues.jp: さくらが俺を見上げて、ニパッと笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles, looking up at me.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles, looking up at me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「教師と教え子のいけない関係だよね？」
dialogues.en:
"It's a forbidden relationship between a teacher and her
student."
dialogues.text:
"It's a forbidden relationship between a teacher and her
student."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「どこをどうやってその答えが出たか知らない
　が、二度と口にしないように」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know how you came up with the answer, but you'd
better not say that again."
dialogues.text:
"I don't know how you came up with the answer, but you'd
better not say that again."

dialogues.jp:
頭を抱えて、大きく、出来るだけ細くため息を
ついた。
dialogues.en: I slowly breathe a sigh, holding my head.
dialogues.text: I slowly breathe a sigh, holding my head.

dialogues.jp: 「公私混同するなと言うただろうが」
dialogues.en: "I told you not to mix private and public matters."
dialogues.text: "I told you not to mix private and public matters."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あの校門をくぐるまでは違うも〜ん♪」
dialogues.en: "We're all private people until we pass the school gate."
dialogues.text: "We're all private people until we pass the school gate."

dialogues.jp: ぎゅぅ、と体全体でさくらがしがみつく。
dialogues.en: Sakura hangs on to me with the weight of her whole body.
dialogues.text: Sakura hangs on to me with the weight of her whole body.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「学校が始まっちゃうと好き好きできないから、
　充電中〜」
dialogues.en: "I can't do this once school starts. So, I'm charging up!"
dialogues.text: "I can't do this once school starts. So, I'm charging up!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……あっそ」
dialogues.en: "Really."
dialogues.text: "Really."

dialogues.jp:
こうなると、充電率１００パーセントになるま
で離す気はないのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I think she won't let go of me until she's 100 percent
charged.
dialogues.text:
I think she won't let go of me until she's 100 percent
charged.

dialogues.jp:
ぼーっと、奇異の目にさらされながら桜並木に
｛たたず／佇｝む。
dialogues.en:
I stand in the grove of cherry blossom trees, getting weird
looks.
dialogues.text:
I stand in the grove of cherry blossom trees, getting weird
looks.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう朝倉君、芳乃先生」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura-kun, Yoshino-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura-kun, Yoshino-sensei."

dialogues.jp: 爽やかさの形容詞みたいに、ことりが笑う。
dialogues.en: Kotori smiles brightly.
dialogues.text: Kotori smiles brightly.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます先輩！」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Good morning, sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「今日も美春は元気だな」
dialogues.en: "You sound like you're ready for the day, Miharu!"
dialogues.text: "You sound like you're ready for the day, Miharu!"

dialogues.jp: 手を振って苦笑いを浮かべる。
dialogues.en: I wave to her with a wry smile.
dialogues.text: I wave to her with a wry smile.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりとも俺の腰元に気まずそうに目をやって
いるのは、しかたあるまい。
dialogues.en: They can't help looking at my waist area embarrassingly.
dialogues.text: They can't help looking at my waist area embarrassingly.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あのぉ……そちらが芳乃先生ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Uhh... Is she Yoshino-sensei?"
dialogues.text: "Uhh... Is she Yoshino-sensei?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そのはずだ」
dialogues.en: "I think so."
dialogues.text: "I think so."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Squeeze!"
dialogues.text: "Squeeze!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なんだか親子みたいですね」
dialogues.en: "You guys look like a parent and a child."
dialogues.text: "You guys look like a parent and a child."

dialogues.jp: 爽やかさの形容詞みたいに、ことりが笑う。
dialogues.en: Kotori smiles brightly.
dialogues.text: Kotori smiles brightly.

dialogues.jp:
「……おい、さくら、今なんパーセントくらい
　だ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey Sakura, how charged are you?"
dialogues.text: "Hey Sakura, how charged are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……４５パーセント」
dialogues.en: "45 percent..."
dialogues.text: "45 percent..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なにやってるんです？　愛情表現？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing? Is that a lovers' private term?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing? Is that a lovers' private term?"

dialogues.jp: ごく当たり前の質問だな。
dialogues.en: It's totally understandable to ask that.
dialogues.text: It's totally understandable to ask that.

dialogues.jp: 「人体発電の実験だ」
dialogues.en:
"It's an experiment on electrical power generation by
humans."
dialogues.text:
"It's an experiment on electrical power generation by
humans."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩は電気ウナギです――わわわ！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sempai is an electric eel... Waaah!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sempai is an electric eel... Waaah!"

dialogues.jp:
ぐぐーっと、余計なことしか言わない美春の額
を押す。
dialogues.en: I push Miharu's forehead. She's always saying silly things.
dialogues.text: I push Miharu's forehead. She's always saying silly things.

dialogues.jp:
「ことり、すまないが美春と先に行っててくれ。
　もう少し時間がかかりそうだ」
dialogues.en:
"Kotori, it'll take a while, so do you mind going with
Miharu?"
dialogues.text:
"Kotori, it'll take a while, so do you mind going with
Miharu?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい。分かりました。任せちゃってください」
dialogues.en: "Sure, no problem. Leave it to me."
dialogues.text: "Sure, no problem. Leave it to me."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ先輩、またです！」
dialogues.en: "See you later, old man!"
dialogues.text: "See you later, old man!"

dialogues.jp:
いつものことなので、お互いに軽く手を振って
別れる。
dialogues.en: We part, waving to each other.
dialogues.text: We part, waving to each other.

dialogues.jp: 限りなく平和な日常だ。
dialogues.en: What a peaceful day today is.
dialogues.text: What a peaceful day today is.

dialogues.jp: 「お前以外はな……」
dialogues.en: "Except for you..."
dialogues.text: "Except for you..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「６７パーセント〜」
dialogues.en: "67 percent..."
dialogues.text: "67 percent..."

dialogues.jp:
さくらの嬉しそうな呟きに、俺はため息をつか
ずにはいられなかった。
dialogues.en: I can't help sighing when I hear Sakura's happy murmuring.
dialogues.text: I can't help sighing when I hear Sakura's happy murmuring.

dialogues.jp: さて、驚いた。
dialogues.en: I was surprised.
dialogues.text: I was surprised.

dialogues.jp: 黒板に規則正しく引かれていく白い線。
dialogues.en: White lines are being drawn on the blackboard.
dialogues.text: White lines are being drawn on the blackboard.

dialogues.jp:
朗々と教科書を読み上げ、解答を一瞬のうちに
導き出して、学生に自信満々に伝える。
dialogues.en:
She reads the textbook energetically, solves the question in
a second, then gives the answer to her students proudly.
dialogues.text:
She reads the textbook energetically, solves the question in
a second, then gives the answer to her students proudly.

dialogues.jp: 「授業になっている……」
dialogues.en: "She's really teaching."
dialogues.text: "She's really teaching."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はい、そこ、私語は慎むように」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me, refrain from talking in class."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me, refrain from talking in class."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか嬉しそうに、それこそ死語でしかない
ようなことを言う、｛・・・・・／さくら先生｝がそこにいた。
dialogues.en:
There's a happy 'Sakura-sensei' in front of me, using
archaic language.
dialogues.text:
There's a happy 'Sakura-sensei' in front of me, using
archaic language.

dialogues.jp:
今は数学の授業だが、さくらの風見学園での担
当は特定されていないらしい。
dialogues.en:
This is a math class, but she doesn't have any special
subject to teach at Kazami Academy.
dialogues.text:
This is a math class, but she doesn't have any special
subject to teach at Kazami Academy.

dialogues.jp:
得意の生物を筆頭に、物理、数学、英語、情報
処理と、気の向くまま授業に参加しているよう
だ。
dialogues.en:
She can teach Science as her forte, but she also teaches
Physics, Mathematics, English and Data Processing as she
wishes.
dialogues.text:
She can teach Science as her forte, but she also teaches
Physics, Mathematics, English and Data Processing as she
wishes.

dialogues.jp:
本来の担当でもある講師も初めてその姿を見た
のか、外見は冷静だが注視してしまっている姿
からさくらの実力が窺える。
dialogues.en:
I can tell Sakura's a great teacher by looking at the other
teachers' reaction, because they're impressed with her
teaching.
dialogues.text:
I can tell Sakura's a great teacher by looking at the other
teachers' reaction, because they're impressed with her
teaching.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「と……まぁ、関数は付属からの流れと同じだ
　から、そう構えなくても解けるわけです……
　だめだこりゃ、次行ってみよ〜♪」
dialogues.en:
"So... A function is the same, just with a number attached,
so it's not that difficult... Oh well... Let's skip to the
next sentence!"
dialogues.text:
"So... A function is the same, just with a number attached,
so it's not that difficult... Oh well... Let's skip to the
next sentence!"

dialogues.jp: 喋りはおかしい。
dialogues.en: She speaks a little weird.
dialogues.text: She speaks a little weird.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、そんなことよりも、唯一で絶対にまずい
欠点があった。
dialogues.en:
But more importantly, there is one drawback everyone can
admit.
dialogues.text:
But more importantly, there is one drawback everyone can
admit.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……あの、先生」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me, sensei."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me, sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はい、なんでしょう白河さん♪」
dialogues.en: "Yes, what is it, Shirakawa-san?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, what is it, Shirakawa-san?"

dialogues.jp:
全身全霊で嬉しさを体中から発散させながら、
さくらが振り返る。
dialogues.en: Sakura turns around, radiating happiness from her body.
dialogues.text: Sakura turns around, radiating happiness from her body.

dialogues.jp: しかし、誰もが分かっていた。
dialogues.en: It's obvious to everyone.
dialogues.text: It's obvious to everyone.

dialogues.jp:
その致命的な欠点に気づいていないのは、間違
いなく当のさくらだけだったのだろう。
dialogues.en:
The only person who hasn't noticed the fatal drawback is
Sakura herself.
dialogues.text:
The only person who hasn't noticed the fatal drawback is
Sakura herself.

dialogues.jp: だから、ことりが手を挙げるしかなかったのだ。
dialogues.en: That's why Kotori had to raise her hand.
dialogues.text: That's why Kotori had to raise her hand.

dialogues.jp: ちなみに俺は面倒だった。
dialogues.en: It was too much of a pain in the neck for me, if you ask me.
dialogues.text: It was too much of a pain in the neck for me, if you ask me.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あの……その……」
dialogues.en: "Uhh... Well..."
dialogues.text: "Uhh... Well..."

dialogues.jp:
何度か言いよどんでから、ことりが胸に手を当
てて真っ直ぐ顔を上げる。
dialogues.en:
Kotori faces toward her, stammering a few times, putting her
hand on her chest.
dialogues.text:
Kotori faces toward her, stammering a few times, putting her
hand on her chest.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「字が読めません……」
dialogues.en: "I can't read your handwriting."
dialogues.text: "I can't read your handwriting."

dialogues.jp:
ひょい、とさくらが黒板を見上げるが、そこに
は宇宙からの電波のような記号が並んでいた。
dialogues.en:
Sakura gives a glance at the blackboard. There are rows of
gibberish symbols that look like some electric wave from
space.
dialogues.text:
Sakura gives a glance at the blackboard. There are rows of
gibberish symbols that look like some electric wave from
space.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、日本語の書きに縁のないさくらがチョー
クを使った結果としては、当たり前だろう。
dialogues.en:
Well, it's understandable that Sakura doesn't write much
Japanese, so if she tries to write with a chalk, she might
not do a good job.
dialogues.text:
Well, it's understandable that Sakura doesn't write much
Japanese, so if she tries to write with a chalk, she might
not do a good job.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜」
◆さくら先生・初授業◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura-sensei's first lecture◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura-sensei's first lecture◆

dialogues.jp:
とても先生には見えないようなさくらと、学園
へと向かう。
dialogues.en:
I walk to school with Sakura, who doesn't look like a
teacher at all.
dialogues.text:
I walk to school with Sakura, who doesn't look like a
teacher at all.

dialogues.jp:
途中、充電されてしまったり、それを他の連中
に見られたりした……。
dialogues.en:
On the way to school, she had to be charged by hanging on to
my body, and people saw that scene.
dialogues.text:
On the way to school, she had to be charged by hanging on to
my body, and people saw that scene.

dialogues.jp:
さて、授業中。驚くべき事に、さくらは、さく
ら先生であった。が……。
dialogues.en: Now, Sakura is teaching our class, but...
dialogues.text: Now, Sakura is teaching our class, but...

dialogues.jp: 字が読めない。
dialogues.en: We can't read her handwriting.
dialogues.text: We can't read her handwriting.
